title: EventBus unknown event and empty registry contract

contract.unknown_event: Emitting an event with no registered listeners succeeds without creating a listener registry entry
contract.empty_registry_delivery: An event with an empty listener registry is accepted and produces no listener invocation
contract.last_listener_removal: Removing the last listener removes the event entry from the registry
contract.post_unregister_emit: Emitting after the last listener is removed remains successful and produces no delivery
contract.registry_stability: Unknown and post-unregister emits do not corrupt or recreate empty listener registries
contract.permission_enforcement: The emitting plugin is checked for the events permission before delivery
